podcast.body: Klaus Nomi's official debut album was released in 1981. It features his distinctive vocal style, demonstrating the qualities that attracted artists like David Bowie. The album includes Nomi's cover of Chubby Checker's "The Twist." "This is from Clouse Nomi's official debut album in 1981."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This self-titled album, released in 1981, marked Nomi's official debut and showcased his distinctive vocal style and theatrical artistry, including his unique cover of "The Twist." "This is from Clouse Nomi's official debut album in 1981."
